description: Flex tenants sleep, so a REST call after idle waits for a wake. For a cheap/free tier, pack many small tenants into one always-on Valkey: the gateway rewrites keys to a tenant prefix and each login gets an ACL limited to ~{prefix}*. Risks to design for: Lua scripts (KEYS[] only, refuse dynamic key access or run scripts on dedicated pods), KEYS/SCAN/FLUSHDB/FLUSHALL, pub/sub channel namespacing, DBSIZE/INFO leakage, memory fairness (per-tenant maxmemory is impossible in a shared process: enforce with usage sampling). Start with REST only; TCP stays pod-per-tenant.
title: Serverless data: shared always-on "nano" Valkey pool (no cold start) with per-tenant key prefix + ACL isolation
